description: What the site says about a policy, quoted from its FAQ and pages: deposit, fees, lease term and moving out, missed payments, what you need to rent, prohibited items and use, insurance, climate control, access and authorized users. Where a term is not published (late fee amounts, notice periods, proration), the answer quotes the site's own statement that the signed rental agreement governs it. Without `topic`, it returns the list of topics.

topic.description: Optional policy topic; the topic list is returned by default.

name: get_policies
